domains.name: Number and Quantity
domains.description: Real and complex numbers, exponents and radicals, ratios, rates, percents, units, vectors and matrices.

skills.name: Number properties and operations
skills.description: Integers, fractions, decimals, factors, multiples and order of operations, including properties of odd, even and prime numbers.

skills.name: Exponents and radicals
skills.description: Using integer and rational exponents, simplifying radicals and working with scientific notation.

skills.name: Ratios, rates and proportions
skills.description: Solving problems with ratios, unit rates and direct proportion in everyday contexts such as recipes, maps and speed.

skills.name: Percentages
skills.description: Percent of a number, percent change, discounts, tax, tips and simple interest.

skills.name: Units and measurement
skills.description: Converting units, keeping track of units in a calculation and estimating with reasonable precision.

skills.name: Complex numbers
skills.description: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing complex numbers, and powers of the imaginary unit.

skills.name: Vectors and matrices
skills.description: Vector components and magnitude, adding vectors, and basic matrix addition, scalar multiplication, multiplication and determinants.

domains.name: Algebra
domains.description: Expressions, equations and inequalities: linear, quadratic, polynomial, radical, absolute value and exponential, and systems of them.

skills.name: Linear equations and inequalities
skills.description: Solving and graphing linear equations and inequalities in one variable, including compound inequalities.

skills.name: Systems of equations
skills.description: Solving systems of two linear equations, and simple linear-quadratic systems, in context and in the abstract.

skills.name: Quadratic equations and factoring
skills.description: Factoring quadratics, solving by factoring or the quadratic formula, and relating roots to factors.

skills.name: Polynomial and rational expressions
skills.description: Adding, multiplying and dividing polynomials, simplifying rational expressions and solving rational equations.

skills.name: Radical, absolute value and exponential equations
skills.description: Solving equations that involve square roots, absolute values or unknown exponents, and checking for extraneous answers.

skills.name: Modeling with equations
skills.description: Translating a word situation into an expression, equation or inequality, then interpreting the solution in context.

skills.name: Lines in the coordinate plane
skills.description: Slope, intercepts, parallel and perpendicular lines and writing the equation of a line through given points.

domains.name: Functions
domains.description: Function notation, domain and range, and the families of linear, quadratic, polynomial, exponential, logarithmic, piecewise and trigonometric functions.

skills.name: Function notation and evaluation
skills.description: Evaluating functions given by a formula, table or graph, and composing two functions.

skills.name: Domain and range
skills.description: Finding the inputs a function allows and the outputs it produces, from a formula or a graph.

skills.name: Linear functions
skills.description: Interpreting rate of change and initial value of a linear function in context and comparing two linear models.

skills.name: Quadratic functions
skills.description: Vertex, intercepts, maximum and minimum values and the graph of a quadratic function.

skills.name: Exponential and logarithmic functions
skills.description: Growth and decay models, compound interest, and using logarithms to solve for an exponent.

skills.name: Transformations of functions
skills.description: How shifts, reflections and stretches change the formula and the graph of a function.

skills.name: Polynomial, rational and piecewise functions
skills.description: Zeros and end behavior of polynomials, asymptotes of rational functions and evaluating piecewise functions.

skills.name: Trigonometric functions
skills.description: The unit circle, radian measure, amplitude and period of sine and cosine graphs, and basic identities.

domains.name: Geometry
domains.description: Shapes and solids, angles, triangles, circles, coordinate geometry, transformations and trigonometry in triangles.

skills.name: Angles, lines and polygons
skills.description: Angle relationships with parallel lines, interior and exterior angles of polygons and properties of quadrilaterals.

skills.name: Triangles, congruence and similarity
skills.description: Triangle inequality, congruence and similarity, and using ratios of similar triangles to find lengths.

skills.name: Right triangles and trigonometry
skills.description: The Pythagorean theorem, special right triangles, sine, cosine and tangent, and the laws of sines and cosines.

skills.name: Circles
skills.description: Circumference, area, arcs, sectors, chords and tangents, and the standard equation of a circle.

skills.name: Area and perimeter
skills.description: Perimeter and area of triangles, rectangles, trapezoids, circles and composite figures.

skills.name: Surface area and volume
skills.description: Surface area and volume of prisms, cylinders, cones, pyramids and spheres, and how they change when dimensions scale.

skills.name: Coordinate geometry
skills.description: Distance, midpoint, slope and the equations of lines and simple conics on the coordinate plane.

skills.name: Transformations
skills.description: Translations, reflections, rotations and dilations of figures in the coordinate plane.

domains.name: Statistics and Probability
domains.description: Describing data, reading tables and charts, modeling relationships, counting and probability.

skills.name: Measures of center
skills.description: Mean, median and mode, weighted averages, and how adding or removing a value changes them.

skills.name: Spread and distributions
skills.description: Range, interquartile range and standard deviation, and comparing the spread and shape of two data sets.

skills.name: Data displays
skills.description: Reading and interpreting tables, bar graphs, histograms, box plots and stem-and-leaf plots.

skills.name: Scatterplots and lines of fit
skills.description: Describing association in a scatterplot and using a line of fit to make predictions.

skills.name: Counting methods
skills.description: The multiplication principle, permutations and combinations for counting outcomes.

skills.name: Probability of events
skills.description: Probability of simple and compound events, complements, and independent and dependent events.

skills.name: Conditional probability and two-way tables
skills.description: Using two-way frequency tables to find joint, marginal and conditional probabilities.

skills.name: Expected value
skills.description: Computing the expected value of a simple random variable and interpreting it as a long-run average.

skills.name: Sampling and study design
skills.description: Random samples, bias, surveys, experiments and observational studies, and what conclusions each supports.
